note: RES.md D10 Phase 4 sub-study 4A: the ONLY place the reference meter count may be hardcoded. Previously 49, the pipeline's original count (set A, simulation/representative_meters.json), which is still the frozen estimator/corpus baseline and is unchanged. Changing this value changes only placement defaults; the live producer/consumer/injector still read simulation/representative_meters.json.
